name: Northern bald ibis
desc: Rediscovered near Palmyra in 2002. It probes the steppe for lizards and darkling beetles. The colony has since died out.
about: The northern bald ibis, hermit ibis, or Waldrapp is a migratory Old World ibis found in open areas such as grasslands, rocky mountains, and semi-deserts, often close to running water.
